notes: Stop-based: only stops are drawn, no zone outline. Stops from 'tod-zone-stops.csv', sent by Mike McConnell (City of Barrie, Transit Project Lead) to Atlas Outreach on 2026-11-17, grouped by zone so each carries its zone name; zone map dates in the file: A 2025-09-21, B 2025-09-21, C 2025-06-08, D 2026-07-29, E 2025-06-08, F 2025-06-08, H 2026-06-29. Zones A to F and H are the zones on the City's Transit ON Demand page; H includes the Reid/Pearen and Reid/McKay pilot stops the page lists. The same email's 'tod-zones-approx.geojson' outlines are marked 'approximate, hand-traced from the public zone maps; not official', so they are not drawn (understate, never overstate). Left out: zone T (Fenchurch Manor, Priscilla's Place), which the City's page doesn't list, and H stop 33, which has no location in the file. Hours from the City's page, the same for every zone; no holiday hours stated. Riders are picked up at the nearest Transit ON Demand stop in their zone; door-to-door is Specialized Transit. Regular Barrie Transit fare; children under 12 ride with an adult.
